name: M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ Carbon Cleanse cleansing powder
shortDescription: A 30 g cleansing powder that turns into a silky foam with water and also removes the microscopic carbon particles left in the pores after carbon peeling. Suitable for sensitive and dehydrated skin too.
description:
LaserIQ Carbon Cleanse Powder is a cleansing powder that turns into a silky, creamy foam on contact with water, developed by M'ONDUNIQ specifically for skincare after LaserIQ Carbon Peeling treatments and for the gentle cleansing of sensitive, reactive and dehydrated skin. The fine powder is worked into a foam with a few drops of water; the active ingredients of the formula remove impurities clinging both to the skin surface and deep in the pores, while supporting the function of the skin's natural protective barrier and preserving the skin's hydration.

During carbon peeling, the carbon mask penetrates deep into the pores, where it binds sebum and impurities. The laser energy removes a large part of these, but microscopic carbon particles may still remain after the treatment. They are usually not visible to the naked eye, yet their presence can hinder optimal skin cleanliness and the absorption of active ingredients applied later – the Carbon Cleanse foam is designed precisely for the gentle removal of these remaining particles.

In addition to carbon particles, the foam also lifts sebum, impurities and dead skin cells, reducing the likelihood of clogged pores and helping serums and creams applied after the treatment absorb better. All this without disrupting the skin's natural protective barrier or irritating freshly treated skin.

The formula contains niacinamide (vitamin B3), allantoin, aloe vera extract and burdock leaf extract. Niacinamide supports barrier function, a more even skin tone and a more refined appearance of pores; allantoin soothes and regenerates; aloe vera extract hydrates intensively; and burdock leaf extract acts as a skin conditioner, contributing to a clear, balanced complexion.

To use, sprinkle a small amount of powder into your moistened palm, work it into a creamy foam with a few drops of water, then gently massage the face for 30–60 seconds – paying particular attention to areas prone to excess sebum production – and finally rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. It is especially recommended for the first at-home facial cleanse after a carbon peeling treatment, and can otherwise be used both morning and evening. The fine powder texture is economical: a small amount is enough for a complete facial cleanse.

Recommended for sensitive, reactive, dehydrated, dull, combination and normal skin alike, and can be used on practically all skin types. Beyond at-home care after carbon peeling, it is also suitable for daily facial cleansing, pore-cleansing routines, preparation for professional treatments and skin preparation before hydrating treatments. This is not just a facial cleanser but one of the most important at-home complements to professional carbon peeling treatments, helping to maintain the treatment results and support healthy skin function.

Immediately after use, a cleaner skin feel, a finer, smoother skin surface, less visible pores and a silky touch are typical. Regular use helps the skin stay clear, smooth and radiant for longer, even between treatment series.
